body:
Resolves #796.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. `renderUsage()` in `packages/tickets/lib/help.mjs` displays `  update <id> --input <path|-> --expect <ticket-hash> [--force] [--write]` so `--expect` is not shown as optional and `--force` is discoverable from top-level usage.
2. Unit tests in `packages/tickets/test/help.test.mjs` verify that `renderUsage()` includes `update <id> --input <path|-> --expect <ticket-hash> [--force] [--write]`.
title: tickets: align top-level update usage line with --expect requirement and --force override (#796)
